status: phase 1 local macOS; independent review and CI pending

method.provider: inherited provider/proxy environment removed after mise; loopback fixtures with dummy credentials
method.spread: minimum and maximum; no samples discarded from final5
method.native_swift: actual headless AKit SessionStore and Rust FFI; excludes SwiftUI/WindowServer
method.browser: complete native DOM; loading probe uses progress counters, then text-node lengths without transcript concatenation
method.excluded: initial prototype and unchunked-cache runs; browser polling runs that repeatedly read textContent; partial seek startup-race run; earlier partial-Markdown web delivery runs, before canonical whole-item rendering

artifacts.source_note: canonical per-item web DOM; bounded batches admit one oversized item; boundary-complete ranges
